extraFacts.fact: SAE J514 and ISO 8434-2 cover 37° flared tube and hose fittings (JIC): the male 37° flare seats metal to metal against the 37° cone of the female swivel nut, and thread sizes are given by dash number, where each dash is one sixteenth of an inch (-04 is 4/16 in, or 1/4 in).

SAE J1453 and ISO 8434-3 cover O-ring face seal (ORFS) fittings: an O-ring seated in a groove in the flat face of the male end seals against the flat face of the female swivel nut, so the seal is made by the O-ring and the thread only holds the joint together.

SAE J518 and ISO 6162 cover four-bolt split-flange connections in two pressure series: Code 61 (the 3000 psi series, ISO 6162-1) and Code 62 (the 6000 psi series, ISO 6162-2). A Code 61 flange head is not interchangeable with a Code 62 clamp, because the bolt spacing differs for the same nominal size.

ASME B1.20.1 covers general-purpose inch pipe threads: NPT is a taper thread with a 60° thread form that seals on the threads, and NPSM is a straight (parallel) thread for free-fitting mechanical joints that does not seal on the thread.
